description: Takes an input image as the first frame and a text prompt, then generates frames from it. Send a photo with a caption.

provenance.source: txt2img_h3_plate plus the first_frame chain used by the Rey_BuNad_* workflows
provenance.note: The 13 base nodes are unchanged from the verified txt2img capture. Nodes 14 (LoadImage) and 15 (ImageScale) were added, and node 1's optional first_frame input wired to them, mirroring the wiring in the user's own image-conditioned workflows.

width.note: Drives both the generation width and the size the input image is scaled to; they must match.

height.note: Drives both the generation height and the input image scale height.

length.note: Frames generated. 5 for a single still; higher values animate away from the input image.

image.note: The uploaded file's name inside ComfyUI's input directory. Set by the orchestrator after a validated upload - never taken from user input.

filename_prefix.note: Set by the orchestrator per job. Never taken from user input.

unsupported.negative_prompt: MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo exposes no negative conditioning input.
unsupported.cfg: This graph uses BasicGuider (no CFG scale input).
unsupported.denoise_strength: The node takes a first frame rather than a denoise ratio, so the input image is a starting frame, not a partially-noised latent.
unsupported.model_choice: Only one diffusion model is installed.
